matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 221-230 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Daniel D Hunter; the Hunter, Hunt, Jackson, Jacobs, Jacobsen, James, Jenkins, Jennings, and Jensen clusters; Lillian S/no-initial Huyck; Mary A/E Hutchison; Joseph H Immel with present/absent private identifier; George R/R.W. Isaac; Ayus Isarasena/Isavasena; Robert Jaffe/Jaffee; and same-initial Harold B Jacobsen rows with different boxes and private-identifier occupancy. The review preserves truncated printed forms, literal capitalization and misspellings such as Marvin lee Hutson, Midred Jacobsen, Dorothyy Jennings, and Jelinkek; project or group headings; foreign and service notes; out-of-sequence boxes and locations; and column shifts exactly as printed. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
